description: Varna (Varan / caste-temperament) koota. Derived from the Moon-sign (rashi) of each partner. Classical grouping: water signs = Brahmin, fire signs = Kshatriya, earth signs = Vaishya, air signs = Shudra.

varna_ranks._comment: Higher rank number = higher varna in the ordering used by the scoring rule. Not a social value judgement; purely the classical scoring order.

scoring.roles: groom vs bride (seeker/partner mapped per manifest.role_mapping)
scoring.rule: Let g = varna_rank(groom.rashi), b = varna_rank(bride.rashi). If g >= b -> 1 point, else 0.

notes: Rashi->varna map by element: Brahmin=Cancer,Scorpio,Pisces (water); Kshatriya=Aries,Leo,Sagittarius (fire); Vaishya=Taurus,Virgo,Capricorn (earth); Shudra=Gemini,Libra,Aquarius (air).
Directional: only a groom-varna-lower-than-bride pairing loses the point; equal or higher scores.
